answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 20460 Country: Pakistan Title: Can money being used for AQIQA be given to a needy person and the obligation of AQIQA fulfilled? Question: Can money being used for AQIQA be given to a needy person and the obligation of AQIQA fulfilled? Answer ID: 20460 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 369/384/B=1431) No, it will not discharge the requirement of Aqiqah. It is sunnah to slaughter a goat which fulfils the provision of Qurbani. As it is obligatory to shed blood i.e. slaughtering animal, in the same way shedding blood is also sunnah in Aqiqah. Merely by giving money to poor, the sunnah of Aqiqah will not be fulfilled. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
